text: According to the book, the time asymmetry of the Second Law of Thermodynamics derives from a time-asymmetry built into the fundamental laws of mechanics themselves.
explanation: False. The fundamental laws of mechanics are, to excellent approximation, time-symmetric, as Loschmidt's reversibility objection shows; the thermodynamic asymmetry instead traces to the special low-entropy initial condition of the universe (the Past Hypothesis). Boltzmann's H-theorem only appeared to derive the asymmetry from mechanics because it quietly assumed time-asymmetric initial conditions through the molecular-chaos assumption.
